_notes: Who owns what (UOrganisationSubsystem). Edit freely; in PIE run adastrea.ReloadOrgs, then adastrea.OrgInfo to check.
organisations[].kind: person (1-2 ships), outfit (family / small company, 2-6), guild (specialists, no territory, up to 8 of its own), authority (governs sectors, up to 20).
organisations[].parent: allegiance. A captain's outfit or guild, a guild's chartering authority. Leave out for independents. Standing is inherited through parents.
organisations[].governs: authority only. Sector ids from Galaxy.json; at most 3, all in one system. Sectors nobody governs are independent space.
ships[]: one ship each, or 'count' for numbered ships sharing a name. role: trader, miner or patrol (patrols fly between stations without trading until patrol AI exists).
ships[].sector: where the ship is. A level's AAIShipPopulator spawns that sector's ships. ships[].class (optional): Blueprint class path, else the populator picks one for the role.
relations[]: standing -100 (war) .. 100 (allies) between two organisations, symmetric. Unlisted pairs sharing an allegiance default to 50, others to 0.
organisations[].taxRate: authority only. Share of the profit other owners' ships make in its sectors (default 0.08). targetFleet: fleet size an authority keeps up (default: what it starts with).
economy: every tickSeconds of game time ships not in the level being played earn offscreenIncome, all ships cost upkeep, authorities get sectorIncome per governed sector.

organisations[].pirate: makes the organisation a pirate gang (no parent; UPirateSubsystem). needs: starting level 0-100 of people, access, parts, supplies, information, cash. upkeep: level lost per economy tick for any of them (defaults 0.5/0.3/2/4/1.5/1). Gangs raid to fill their shortages; parts decide how many ships they can send. adastrea.PirateInfo shows them.
economy: owners in debt sell a ship that isn't in view (for shipPrice x resaleFraction); owners with shipPrice x (1 + reserveFraction) buy one, up to their cap. adastrea.EconomyTick N runs ticks now.
